California “Do Not Sell My Info” Opt-Out

If you are a California consumer (as that term is defined in the CCPA), you have the right to opt-out of the “sale” of your Personal Information on a going-forward basis, as “sale” is defined in the CCPA.You may request to exercise this opt-out by filling out the webform on the right.

You may also exercise this opt-out by emailing us at [email] and providing sufficient information to us so that we may process your opt-out request, in particular the information requested below.
